title: Molecular docking analysis of PARgamma with compounds from Ocimum tenuiflorum.
authors: Rajagopal, Ponnulakshmi; Jayaraman, Selvaraj; Jh, Shazia Fathima; Radhakrishnan, Saravanan; Laxman, Patil Ashlesh; Krishnan Muthaiah, Vijaya Prakash; Tripathi, Satyendra Chandra; Gugapriya, T S; Tarnekar, Aaditya Madhusudan; Girish Muthiyan, Gayatri; Deshmukh, Vishwajit Ravindra; Sontakke, Bharat Ramrao; Chandrashekar, Kirubhanand
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接分析植物化合物与PPARγ转录因子的结合，虽涉及TF-配体互作，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: The ligand-activated transcription factor peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor (PPAR) has become a major target for type 2 diabetes. It belongs to the nuclear receptor superfamily, which controls the expression of proteins involved in glucose metabolism, lipid metabolism, adipocyte proliferation and differentiation, and insulin sensitivity. Ocimum tenuiflorum, often known as Krishna tulsi, is the most sacred herb in India. It was utilized for a variety of medicinal purposes. Therefore, it is of interest to document the molecular docking analysis data of PARgamma modulators from Ocimum tenuiflorum. Four of the twenty substances (rosmarinic acid, permethrin, luteolin, and isosakuranetin) have a considerable binding affinity for the PPARgamma. These phytochemicals are a source of potential anti-diabetic medicines.
abstract_zh: 配体激活的转录因子过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（PPAR）已成为2型糖尿病的主要靶点。它属于核受体超家族，该家族控制着参与葡萄糖代谢、脂质代谢、脂肪细胞增殖与分化以及胰岛素敏感性的蛋白质表达。Ocimum tenuiflorum，通常称为Krishna tulsi，是印度最神圣的草药，被用于多种药用目的。因此，记录来自Ocimum tenuiflorum的PPARγ调节剂的分子对接分析数据具有重要意义。二十种物质中的四种（迷迭香酸、氯菊酯、木犀草素和异樱花素）对PPARγ具有显著的结合亲和力。这些植物化学物质是潜在抗糖尿病药物的来源。
